pdf.aiSubtitle: Ethical Monetization Designer - AI Recommended PDF
pdf.dataSubtitle: Ethical Monetization Designer - Your Data PDF
pdf.aiSummaryHigh: The plan can become stronger by reducing pressure before final review. Prioritize caps, clear purchase value, and fewer interruption points.
pdf.aiSummaryReady: The plan is close to review-ready. Use the pitch to show how the design protects player choice while still supporting revenue.
pdf.noAiSuggestionHelp: Chat with the AI assistant and summarize suggestions before exporting the PDF.
pdf.suggestedPitchBody: {{title}} uses monetization as optional value rather than forced progress. Ads should appear at controlled moments with visible caps, while IAP items should clearly state price and player benefit. The strongest argument for this plan is that players can decline offers and still enjoy the normal game loop.
pdf.frequencyCapStandard: Every ad placement has a cap per session or per day.
pdf.optionalityStandard: Players can decline ads and purchases without losing normal progress.
pdf.priceClarityStandard: Every paid item has a visible price and a concrete benefit.
pdf.pitchEvidenceStandard: The final pitch names caps, optionality, and clear value as ethics evidence.
pdf.dataSummary: {{title}} is a {{platform}} {{genre}} game for {{audience}}. The monetization approach uses {{ads}} ad placement(s) and {{iap}} in-app purchase item(s), with a focus on optional value, clear player benefit, and pressure control.
pdf.noCoreLoop: No core loop has been described yet.
pdf.capsExplanation: Caps limit ad pressure and protect player autonomy.
pdf.optionalValueExplanation: Rewarded ads and IAP should remain optional, not required for normal progress.
pdf.priceClarityExplanation: Every paid item should show price and benefit clearly.
pdf.pressureExplanation: Interstitials and missing caps increase pressure risk.

tips.setupAudience: Define the target audience clearly so monetization choices match player expectations.
tips.setupCoreLoop: Describe the core loop as a sequence: start, action, outcome, reward, upgrade.
tips.setupGenre: Avoid overly broad genre labels when player behavior is important, such as match-3, idle, or collection.
tips.buildRewarded: Rewarded ads should be useful choices, not requirements to keep playing.
tips.buildCap: Set frequency caps before moving to the guardrail check.
tips.buildIap: IAP items should state the price and benefit clearly in one sentence.
tips.guardrailHighRisk: Fix high-risk issues first, especially missing ad caps or unclear purchase value.
tips.guardrailInterstitial: Interstitial ads add more pressure than rewarded ads, so use them sparingly.
tips.guardrailFairPlan: A fair plan lets players decline offers without blocking normal progress.
tips.outputPitch: Your pitch should explain why the plan is fair, not only how it earns money.
tips.outputEvidence: Use frequency caps and optional choices as evidence for player autonomy.
tips.outputReview: Before submitting, check that every item has a clear price and benefit.
